bullets.title: AVGO: Bull case $400B+ '28 AI revenue; JPM, MS, OPCO all positively positioned ahead of Sept 2 print
bullets.body: Consensus expects AVGO to report FY3Q AI revenue ~$16.3B (vs $16B guide), guide FY4Q ~$22.5B, and raise FY27 AI revenue guide toward $120B+. JPM buyside survey pegs >150% YoY AI rev growth with some pushing $130B for FY27; Morgan Stanley models $21.2B in Oct quarter and ~$120B for 2027 (sees $150B as possible but not base). OPCO goes furthest, projecting $400B+ in '28 vs street at $250B, with 5-yr LTA with Google and 5 hyperscaler customers ramping. AVGO trades 16x CY27 EPS vs AI peers at 30x; stock flat YTD vs semis +60%.

bullets.title: NVDA: 70% FY28 revenue growth guide reignites AI complex; BofA PT $350, trades at 13x vs peers
bullets.body: NVDA guided ~70% top-line growth for FY28 (implying ~$1T revenue) vs Street consensus ~44-45%, driven by agentic AI and enterprise demand above supply. Stock rose 8.7% on earnings; SMH rallied 3.1%. UBS Hot Chips analysis shows Rubin platform delivering 10-30x token throughput/MW vs Blackwell. Bank of America has $350 PT citing 34-50% undervaluation, noting NVDA backstops up to $105B of OpenAI data center residual value. OPCO targets $500 stock on peer multiple parity. NVDA also acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9B to extend into model/developer layer.

bullets.title: AVGO/NVDA: SK Hynix mulls Intel for HBM4E base dies; MU struggles with HBM4 yields
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm SK Hynix is in talks to outsource next-gen HBM base die production to Intel Foundry Services, diversifying away from TSMC. Separately, SemiAnalysis reports SK Hynix had to redesign its HBM4 base die, delaying Rubin platform shipments; Samsung currently leads on HBM4 performance. NVDA is reportedly considering HBM4 8-Hi (not 12-Hi) for VR300 given supply constraints. UBS memory monthly forecasts HBM demand at 61.5bn Gb in 2027 (+91% YoY).

bullets.title: MDB: Hedgeye and Jefferies both long with 30% upside; Atlas accelerating, AI workloads ramping
bullets.body: Hedgeye initiates long MDB at $579 PT (30%+ upside) citing Atlas growth at/above 29% for 4 consecutive quarters (troughed at 24%), platform attach among $100K+ customers rising from 37% to 45%, and net ARR expansion improving to 121%. MongoDB beat the high end of guidance in 34 consecutive quarters. Jefferies separately models FQ2 Atlas growth ~30.5-31% vs 26% guided and FQ3 guide ~27% vs Street 22.9%. Key risk: Postgres gaining share on DB-Engines while MongoDB usage metrics are negative in Stack Overflow surveys.

bullets.title: SNOW: Earnings this week; Jefferies and Wolfe both expect inflection print with AI acceleration
bullets.body: Jefferies models FQ2 product revenue at 36% YoY vs guided 29.8-30.2%, and FQ3 guide of 32.5% vs Street 29.9%. Wolfe sees SNOW as the strongest reporter this week—CoCo exited at nine-figure run rate, FDE deals signed, AI growth post-Summit significant. Wolfe forecasts FY27 guidance raise to $5,925M (+32.5%) vs prior $5,840M.

bullets.title: PINS: CFO Julia Brau Donnelly departs Oct 30; KeyBanc maintains OW $30 PT
bullets.body: Pinterest CFO Julia Brau Donnelly resigned effective October 30 for an external opportunity; VP of Finance Vikram Naidu appointed interim CFO. Stock fell ~3.1-3.3% pre-market. KeyBanc maintains OW at $30 PT, noting smooth transition given Naidu's prior experience and that the CFO departure removes near-term acquisition speculation. Under Donnelly, consensus upgraded 2026E MAUs from 539M to 640M and EBITDA from $1.17B to $1.47B.

bullets.title: META: $17B teen safety settlement with 52 AGs removes key overhang; MS upgrades to OW $775
bullets.body: META settled teen social media addiction claims with 52 attorneys general, paying up to $18B over 10 years with 2-hour daily limits for U18 users on FB/IG. Morgan Stanley upgrades to OW with $775 PT, drawing analogy to GOOGL's 40% multiple expansion post-DOJ ruling in Sept 2025—settlement acts as clearing event enabling product innovation (Hatch agentic product, Watermelon model). Teen revenue is <1% of META total; 2026 will see $10B legal charge. META trades at 16x EPS, ~25% below long-term average.

bullets.title: CRM: +22% week after earnings; SaaS re-acceleration led by Agentforce ARR >$1.5B
bullets.body: Salesforce jumped 22.4% in 5 days, largest move since 2020, following 2Q beat with 14% cRPO growth (strongest NNAOV in 4 years) and FY27 guide raised $300M to $46.1-46.4B. Agentforce/Data 360 ARR hit $3.9B (+210% YoY including AI offerings); Agentforce standalone ARR exceeded $1.5B growing >240% YoY. Citi views spillover to IT services as limited; Wolfe separately notes INTU's FY27 guidance disappointed at 9-10% vs consensus 11%.

bullets.title: INTC: 14A defect density improving faster than expected; SK Hynix potential foundry win
bullets.body: OPCO notes Intel's 14A defect density improving faster than expected. In a separate catalyst, SK Hynix is reportedly in talks to outsource HBM4E base die production to Intel Foundry, which would be a significant design win for IFS. Jefferies also flags SK Hynix consideration of Intel for HBM4E. INTC 110 call sweeps of $2.3M (42.7x V/OI) spotted in options flow.

bullets.title: AAPL: CEO transition Monday—Ternus era begins; Tim Cook moves to Chairman
bullets.body: John Ternus officially becomes Apple CEO on September 1, replacing Tim Cook who transitions to Chairman. Cook's tenure saw AAPL grow from $350B to $4.7T ($32M/hour). Ternus is prioritizing AI with an ambitious device slate including foldable iPhone and smart displays. Separately, OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly hoarding tens of thousands of Apple Mac mini/Mac Studio units for reinforcement learning, positioning AAPL as unintended AI beneficiary. Apple TV+ raising prices to $14.99/mo (fourth increase in 4 years).

bullets.title: AMD/CSCO: MI355X AI infrastructure goes live in Saudi Arabia; 1GW target by 2030
bullets.body: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure powered by AMD EPYC CPUs and Cisco Silicon One networking is now live in Saudi Arabia via HUMAIN joint venture. AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN plan to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure starting in 2027 and 1 GW by 2030. UBS Hot Chips notes AMD MI455X combines N2/N3P design with 432GB HBM4 and 23.3TB/s bandwidth; Helios system delivers 2.9 exaflops. AMD software (ROCm) remains the key variable for share gains vs NVDA.

bullets.title: LITE: Evercore initiates at Outperform $1,100 PT; ECOC invited talks validate VCSEL thesis
bullets.body: Evercore ISI initiated Lumentum at Outperform with a $1,100 price target. Separately, Lumentum has two invited talks at ECOC 2026, confirming VCSEL focus. InP foundry operator Landmark reported 121% YoY revenue growth with 57.5% gross margin and 'very, very tight' capacity—positive read-through for LITE and COHR as laser/optical supply chain beneficiaries. TSM VP also identified lasers, fiber, and connectors as key optical scaling bottlenecks.

bullets.title: TTD: +3.6-3.9% pre-market after recent momentum; DKNG DKeX volumes surge into football season
bullets.body: Trade Desk gained 3.6-3.9% in pre-market Monday. DraftKings' DKeX prediction market saw record daily volumes Aug 27-29 ($9.55M, $14.81M, $28.27M); combo volume spiked with NFL season approaching. DKNG viewed by Mizuho as attractive risk/reward ahead of 9th Circuit prediction markets ruling September 6. Oppenheimer maintains Overweight with bullish catalysts building.

bullets.title: ANET: Top-5 requested meeting at Citi TMT Conference; CFO to show accelerating 2027 sales growth
bullets.body: Citi highlights ANET in the top 5 most-requested meetings at their Sept 8-10 TMT Conference with CFO participation. Top 20 conference request list shifted 80/20 toward semis/hardware vs. 50/50 last year. Citi views ANET as positioned to show accelerating 2027 sales growth. Data center interconnect demand expected to grow as AI clusters spread across distributed geographic regions (DCI demand growing per Dell'Oro cited by COHR/CIEN/MRVL/LITE/ANET observers).

bullets.title: DELL/HPE earnings this week; DELL EPS est $4.91 on $44.93B rev; HPE est $0.93 on $11.97B
bullets.body: DELL reports Tuesday after close (est EPS $4.91, rev $44.93B); HPE reports Wednesday after close (est EPS $0.93, rev $11.97B). Key themes: AI server demand and networking upgrade cycles. CIEN reports Thursday pre-open (est EPS $1.73, rev $1.64B). UBS ranks DELL, MDB, SNOW, PANW, AVGO as the key earnings events of the week for software and AI infrastructure positioning.

bullets.title: PLTR: Fair value scenario range $90-$240; bullish on ontology moat but cautious on valuation
bullets.body: Multiple analysts note PLTR's AI acceleration via AIP with net dollar retention at ~160% and operating leverage driving margin expansion. Commercial growth recently outpacing government. The ontology moat and switching costs are viewed as durable. However, analysts caution the valuation range is wide ($90-$240 fair value) and remain on sidelines above $100; stock fell 1.4% pre-market on Monday.

bullets.title: EQIX: Citi top pick; CHTR/CMCSA Buy on valuation; SpaceX broadband threat weighs on telecom
bullets.body: Citi maintains EQIX as top-ranked pick and Focus List Buy. T and VZ Buy-rated on stabilizing competitive landscape with upside bias on telco financial performance in 2H26. CMCSA and CHTR Buy-rated on valuation and potential for better 2H26 after tough first half. Comm services stocks broadly under pressure from SpaceX's ambitions to expand broadband and enter mobile. Separately, EU Digital Services Act content moderation rules tightening on RDDT and RBLX.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $99B unrealized equity gains from SpaceX/Anthropic; Maps renamed Lake Ontario to Lake America
bullets.body: GOOGL booked $99B in equity gains (mostly unrealized) from SpaceX and Anthropic stakes in Q2 2026. AMZN recorded $53.4B in non-operating income from Anthropic preferred stock markups. Separately, Google Maps changed Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' for US users per Reuters/State Department request. Google also retreating on 'parasite SEO' crackdown in Europe to head off EU antitrust action.

bullets.title: NFLX: Wolfe raises PT on stronger 3Q content slate; DIS at 14.5x P/E with 12% 2-yr EPS CAGR
bullets.body: Wolfe Research raises NFLX price target on stronger Q3 content pipeline vs weak Q2 (4 new seasons vs 2). AAPL TV+ price increase to $14.99 signals NFLX retains pricing power. Disney upgraded to Outperform with 8% EPS growth in '27 and 2-year CAGR of 12% plus 1.4% dividend yield = 13.4% total return potential; trades at 14.5x NTM P/E. Supino at Wolfe sees DIS as 'more opportunity than risk' among large-caps.

bullets.title: GEV/GNRC: Trump bulk-power EO creates overhang on GNRC; GEV wins UK substation deal
bullets.body: Trump executive order targets foreign equipment in bulk-power systems (69+ kV transmission). GNRC confirmed no large MW products in front-of-meter applications, but EO creates overhang until DOE finalizes rules within 120 days. GEV selected by Laing O'Rourke for 400kV gas-insulated switchgear substation in UK and signed VSC-HVDC JV with Korea's LS Electric. Clean energy stocks down ~5.8% last week; SHLS won $96M patent case.
